mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (supply) and housing starts (demand) indicates a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations face pressure from higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations rise without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units in the most recent month signals weak residential construction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening regime (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM), a further decline in unemployment rate signals excessive labor market strength, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as inflationary pressures mount and the Fed is forced to raise rates.
regime_hint: labor market tightening (UNRATE < 3.5%, PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when the labor market tightening regime is active and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market and aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy faces a potential recession risk.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
